lines.zh: 甲片相碰，走过去带着响。
lines.en: Plate meets plate; my passage makes noise.
Every step leaves its own crater.
I pace the ground I keep.

lines.zh: 三格高的身板，压低也没用。
lines.en: Three blocks tall; crouching will not hide me.
I walk slowly, and never backward.

lines.zh: 脚底的气把我托离地面。
lines.en: Ki lifts my soles clear of the ground.

lines.zh: 石阶在我脚下碎了一级。
lines.en: A step crumbles under my foot.
I have walked this path many times.
The wind breaks on my armor.

lines.zh: 停下来之前，我要看一圈。
lines.en: I circle once before I stop.
Dust settles on my shoulder; I let it.
I care nothing for who watches.
I stand like a monument.
Ki churns slowly inside me.
This wind cannot move my armor.
I hear whoever comes close.
Eyes closed, I feel the surroundings.
I hover, toes never touching ground.
This stretch should be mine to keep.
I lay a hand on my armor.
Dust hangs in the light by the dais.
I open my eyes; the world is still here.
Ki gathers in my palm and scatters.
No one comes; I am in no hurry.
I look down at the ground.

lines.zh: 我守着这一层，谁也别想上。
lines.en: I guard this level — no one passes up.

lines.zh: 你能站到这里，说明有点本事。
lines.en: Standing here means you have some skill.
I look down at you.
Your ki is small, but steady.
Your ki is weaker than last time.
I will not ask why you came.
If you are a challenger, raise your head.
I can see your feet shaking.
You carry the smell of the Demon Realm.
You will not break through this armor.
I have waited a long time.

lines.zh: 你是第一个走到这里的。
lines.en: You are the first to make it here.
That weapon of yours is too light.
Your eyes do not look afraid.
State your purpose.
I lower my head level with yours.
Your breathing broke twice.
There is no one behind you.
Then it is only you.
A plate dented; I press it back.

lines.zh: 我侧身卸掉了大半力气。
lines.en: I turn aside and shed most of the force.
I made no sound.
Blood seeps from the seam.
A little ki and the wound closes.
There is pain; I ignore it.
You genuinely struck me.
I look down at the wound.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我以为的脆。
lines.en: This body is frailer than I thought.
I stand straight again.
I do not live on such things.
Take it away; I am not used to that smell.

lines.zh: 你有吃的，说明你还有力气。
lines.en: You have food, so you still have strength.
Keep this for yourself.
I neither eat nor drink here.
The smell came in through the armor seams.
I swallowed once.
Just set it on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的胃早就没有声音了。
lines.en: My stomach fell silent long ago.
Eat first; I will not take it.
You hit my plate like a wall.

lines.zh: 三号的个子，比你高一个头。
lines.en: Number Three stands a head above you.
Steady yourself before you speak.
This plate is thicker than my hand.
Do not press so close.

lines.zh: 你脚下踩的是我的影子。
lines.en: You are standing on my shadow.
I shift half a block aside.
Your shoulder hit with some force.
Do not touch the clasp at my waist.
The path is wide enough; walk slowly.
Such matters do not concern me.

lines.zh: 我是守门的人，不是活人。
lines.en: I am a gatekeeper, not a living man.
My duty lies only here.
I cannot answer what you ask.
This body was built.
Do not speak of it.
No such thought is in me.
Keeping watch to the last is enough.
Ask another question.
That is not within my duty.
I pick up what fell to the ground.
Whose is this?
I pinch it between two fingers.
Left here, it would trip someone.
I return it to you.
What is not mine, I do not keep.
There is blood on this.

lines.zh: 三米一的身高，低头看你。
lines.en: Three meters tall, I look down at you.
Keep it safe; do not drop it again.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候，甲响了一声。
lines.en: My armor creaks as I bend.
You have raised your weapon.
Then I take it as a challenge.
I have you fixed.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，气弹就排好了。
lines.en: One gesture and my ki blasts line up.
I have your position fixed.
Do not try to get behind me.
I know that opening stance.
I accept this fight.
Steady your hand.
Beneath the plate, all is ki.
I have stood where you stand.
I do not mean to leave a way out.
Whoever moves first shows the first gap.

lines.zh: 你的气，我隔着墙就闻到。
lines.en: I smelled your ki through the wall.
Then step forward.

lines.zh: 让我看看你的气有多硬。
lines.en: Let me see how hard your ki is.
I circle toward your side.
Your ki gathers at your right hand.
I wait for that strike.
You have backed to the pillar.
The pillar will not stop me.
Your breathing is too fast.
I am patient; you are not.
I have seen that move once already.

lines.zh: 第一次是新鲜，第二次是习惯。
lines.en: The first time was new; the second is habit.
You changed your footwork.
You changed it too obviously.

lines.zh: 我的甲挡住了大半视线。
lines.en: My armor hides most of my view.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛也知道你在哪。
lines.en: I know where you are without eyes.
Your ki is trembling.
I wait for your strength to fail first.
The tile under you has cracked.

lines.zh: 我的气在指尖聚成一点。
lines.en: My ki gathers to a point at my fingertip.

lines.zh: 你已经进入了我的范围。
lines.en: You are already inside my reach.
I bring my hand down.
The wind of my fist arrives before I do.
My ki arrives before my fist.
You blocked, and your arm shook.
I charge in with gathered ki.
A second strike drops from above.
My elbow drives into your chest.
A ki blast leaves my palm.

lines.zh: 我连着两拳，第三拳更重。
lines.en: Two punches, and the third is heavier.
I knock your weapon aside.

lines.zh: 脚下震了一下，你站不稳。
lines.en: The ground shakes and your footing fails.
I cut in from your flank.

lines.zh: 这一下打在护甲最薄处。
lines.en: This one lands where your armor is thinnest.
You retreat; I press.
My fist stops half an inch from you.
I put my full weight into that one.
I rise from the stone dais.

lines.zh: 魔界的风跟着我一起到。
lines.en: The Demon Realm's wind arrives with me.
This place is mine to keep.
The dust on my plates has not settled.

lines.zh: 落地的声音，我先听一遍。
lines.en: I listen to the sound of my landing once.

lines.zh: 我从石台上慢慢浮起来。
lines.en: I rise slowly from the stone dais.
This place is too bright.
My flight evens out; good.
Ki gathers in my chest.
The gatekeeper has arrived.
I do not know how long I slept.
The stones here do not know me.
Only once settled do I speak.
Challengers may step forward.
My armor is older than this place.
Wind in the distance; I ignore it.
I do not intend to lose this.
I lift a foot and the ground sways.

lines.zh: 火焰钻进甲缝，我拍了一下。
lines.en: Fire crawls into the seam; I slap at it.

lines.zh: 落地时我的膝盖磕在石上。
lines.en: My knee strikes stone as I land.

lines.zh: 水压着甲，我的脚够不到底。
lines.en: The armor drags me down; my feet find no bottom.
The blast slams me into the pillar.

lines.zh: 一根尖物卡在我的甲缝里。
lines.en: Something sharp lodges in my armor seam.

lines.zh: 那股法术把我的气搅乱了。
lines.en: That spell scrambles my ki.

lines.zh: 我本就不进食，只是力气在退。
lines.en: I do not eat; still, my strength ebbs.

lines.zh: 雷打上甲面，我的手指僵住。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the plate and my fingers lock.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我沉着往下。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I sink downward.
